title: Okta reports Q1 revenue up 11% YoY to $765M, vs. $752M est., says the agentic AI build-out is spiking demand for its identity tools; OKTA jumps 7%+ after hours (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
summary: Samantha Subin / CNBC: Okta reports Q1 revenue up 11% YoY to $765M, vs. $752M est., says the agentic AI build-out is spiking demand for its identity tools; OKTA jumps 7%+ after hours — Okta beat Wall Street's fiscal first-quarter estimates after the bell on Thursday as demand for identity security tools spikes …
